label: Fisheries · side renewal tabs
description: Green Canada-Fisheries header and two side tabs. The source captions 1971–1972; faint tab markings are not reconstructed.

label: Fisheries · plain five-digit base
description: Undated five-digit example in the Fisheries gallery. Its adjacent tab plate does not establish this specimen’s issue period.

label: Fisheries / Pêches · 1976–1978
description: Bilingual six-digit base. The photographed leading zero is retained; allocation limits are not documented.

label: R.C.A.F. · Sea Island 1957
description: Stacked 1957 at left, two-line station legend and R-prefix number; source identifies Royal Canadian Air Base Sea Island.

label: Royal Canadian Air Force · ambulance
description: Source captions the 1950s–1960s. Wide narrow plate with AMB suffix; precise manufacturing period and dimensions are unconfirmed.

label: Department of National Defence · 1968
description: Cream plate with DND between small dark maple leaves. Source photograph is captioned 1968; no B.C. supplier attribution is inferred.

label: PPCLI · Air Comdet reference
description: Source identifies PPCLI at Kapyong Barracks, Shilo, Manitoba. Faded AIR COMDET and faint 2PPCLI are context only; road-registration status and date are uncertain.

label: CANADA · red leaves, five digits
description: World License Plates captions its black-number examples 1970s–1980s. License Plate Mania shows a related dark-green-number example without a date. Both palettes are provided; identical tooling is not certified.

palettes.label: Dark green serial · undated Mania example

label: CANADA · green leaves, five digits
description: Green leaves and narrower, lighter green numerals; source captions military vehicles in Canada and overseas, 1970s–1980s. Kept separate from the heavier red-leaf examples.

label: Military gallery · flag plate (unattributed)
description: The gallery explicitly captions this flag plate Unknown. Kept as an uncertain reference rather than assigning an issue year, maker or authenticated federal registration.

label: Military · 1950s chamfered base
description: White characters on black with chamfered upper corners. Source captions Canada and Europe in the 1950s; separate from the rectangular base.

label: Military · 1950s rectangular base
description: Two rectangular black examples support different number/letter group lengths. Pattern validation does not establish exhaustive military allocations.

label: Forces in Europe · blue CANADA base
description: White WF85 above CANADA on blue. Source gives 1950s–1960s, not a precise introduction date.

label: Germany · blue maple separator
description: Source captions 1957–1960. White maple between the four-character run and final letter; no CANADA header.

label: Canadian Army · Germany
description: CANADIAN ARMY / GERMANY on blue with maple and round red seal. Seal detail is not resolved in the source and is represented only schematically.

label: Germany · blue CANADA base
description: Blue base, white CANADA, red maple and green validation panel. Validation-panel microtext is omitted rather than invented.

label: Germany · red leaves base
description: Four digits and G-prefix example share this observed red-letter red-leaf layout. Source identifies G with Gelsenkirchen; no full code dictionary or supplier is inferred.

label: Germany · Exchange
description: EX = Exchange in the source caption. Small left-side attachment is preserved as an unlettered dark box because its detail is unresolved.

label: Germany · trailer red-leaf base
description: Trailer T-prefix uses the red-leaf layout. Its relation to the car base is visual support, not recovered die identity.

label: Germany · motorcycle red-leaf base
description: Compact motorcycle shell and smaller condensed lettering are treated separately from the car and trailer stamp sizes.

label: Germany · blue trailer base
description: TH trailer prefix on blue, central maple and red validation panel. Validation text is not legible and is omitted.

label: Europe · red block letters, compact
description: Source captions the block-letter compact example 1985–2016. Mania photographs SN475 with a pink annual sticker, including a compact shell. Sticker date is not the base manufacture date.

label: Europe · red block letters, long layout
description: Mania shows the same SN475 on a wider, shallower shell. This photographed layout is separate from the compact example; precise dimensions, front/rear designation and date are unconfirmed.

label: Europe · red narrow letters, compact
description: World License Plates captions the narrow-letter WD661 example 1990s–2016, overlapping the block-letter format. Mania adds WD568 and WD620; their photograph dates are unknown. Center annual sticker is schematic.

label: Germany · CDN 2016 series, long
description: Source labels 2016 Series, establishing an introduction/example year with no end date. Black angular lettering is an illustrative candidate, not authenticated FE-Schrift tooling.

label: Germany · CDN 2016 series, stacked
description: Stacked letters/digits and CDN at lower left. Source labels 2016 Series; the circular 17 mark is renewal evidence, not an end date. Angular die contours and seal detail remain approximate.

label: RCAF · 2nd Wing, France
description: Long green 2nd Wing plate at Grostenquin, France, with oval F country identifier. Tiny emblems inside the oval are unresolved and omitted.

label: Canadian Armed Forces · 1 Wing attachment
description: Red attachment with CANADIAN ARMED FORCES / 1 WING. Source identifies Marville, France; no date or independent vehicle registration is supplied.

label: RCAF · 3rd Wing, long base
description: Black base at Third Wing Zweibrücken. Source caption spans 1952–1969; the photographed AF number does not certify a complete allocation.

label: RCAF · 4th Wing, long base
description: Green base at Fourth Wing Baden-Söllingen, captioned 1952–1970. Separate station/date/palette provenance; shared construction remains an illustration.

label: RCAF · 3rd Wing, CANADA base
description: Compact black CANADA-header base at Third Wing Zweibrücken, captioned 1963–1969. Tall light strokes differ from the long station plate.

label: RCAF · 4th Wing, CANADA base
description: Compact black CANADA-header base at Fourth Wing Baden-Söllingen, captioned 1963–1970.

label: Royal Canadian Air Force · 4(F) Wing booster
description: Source explicitly calls this a Fourth Wing booster plate. Undated souvenir with fixed words, no registration serial.
